title: OpenAI just built a keyboard, It's called the Codex Micro
description:
OpenAI's Codex Micro isn't a traditional keyboard. It's a dedicated controller built for AI-assisted software development.

Designed around Codex, it gives developers physical controls for managing AI agents, reviewing code, triggering common workflows, and tracking agent activity through dedicated status keys instead of constantly switching between windows.

As AI coding agents become part of everyday development, we're starting to see a new category of hardware built specifically for working alongside them.

#openai #codex #ai #developer #coding #hardware
